notes.title: Coming up! Gecata 5.9 release
notes.notes:
Hey there, gamers! We have some great news for you!

Gecata 5.9 will be released soon! We’ve added Spanish to our interface languages, rearranged the preferences so they’re more logical and intuitive, improved the functionality, and made setting up the overlay’s position more straightforward. And yes, thanks a lot for your feedback! This release includes some tweaks in program features and interface that wouldn’t have been there without your requests!

Stay tuned, the new Gecata is almost here!

Yours always,

Gecata Team.

notes.title: Coming up! Gecata 5.8 release
notes.notes:
Hey there, gamers! We’re happy to bring you great news today!

The brand-new Gecata 5.8 is on its way to your wish-list, promising some new great opportunities to make game recording easier and more fun. We’ve added new language options to the interface, integrated a video manager into the program so that you can edit and convert your footage on the go, and made sharing on YouTube possible directly from the program. What’s more, it’s all packed into a completely new design that we hope you’ll like!

Can’t wait to test the new build? Don’t worry, it won’t be long!

Yours always,

Gecata Team.
